svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a violet resist with two narrow windows lies on a flat pale oxide that buries three thin purple pads. After it the resist is gone and under each window a small hole with sloping walls goes down through the oxide and a thin hatched film to the top of a purple pad.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a violet resist with two narrow windows lies on a flat pale oxide that buries three thin purple pads. After it the resist is gone and under each window a small hole with sloping walls goes down through the oxide and a thin hatched film to the top of a purple pad.
svg.text: A fluorocarbon plasma etches the holes through the oxide and
the nitride cap to the local interconnect; the resist is stripped.
After: two tapered holes down to the local interconnect
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
